svg.title: Star Chart: Gilded star atlas
svg.desc: Star Chart (1D): a gilded star atlas, gold-leaf stars on lapis. The player is redrawing the Stag from fragments of lore: four of its lines are already laid in gold, and a fifth is being dragged from the last star toward the next antler star, while a flickering false star waits to break any line that touches it. Torn paper fragments on the right give the constraints, and the name at the top fills in letter by letter as the constellation comes right.
